# Champion Footballer

Champion Footballer is the ultimate football management platform for creating leagues, tracking player stats, and organizing matches.

## Core Features
- [Home Dashboard](https://championfootballer.co.uk/home)
- [All Leagues](https://championfootballer.co.uk/all-leagues)
- [All Players](https://championfootballer.co.uk/all-players)
- [All Matches](https://championfootballer.co.uk/all-matches)
